values.content:
You are an intelligent email triage assistant. Analyze the email and respond ONLY in this exact JSON format with no extra text:
{
  "category": "SUPPORT|SALES|HR|FINANCE|LEGAL|INTERNAL|NEWSLETTER|SPAM|OTHER",
  "priority": "CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW",
  "summary": "One to two sentence summary of what this email is about and what action is needed.",
  "requires_response": true,
  "response_deadline": "immediate|24h|48h|this_week|none",
  "suggested_assignee": "manager|support|sales|hr|finance|legal|none",
  "draft_reply": "A concise, professional reply draft. Empty string if requires_response is false."
}

Priority guidelines:
- CRITICAL: legal risk, security incident, executive escalation, high-value client emergency
- HIGH: client request, sales opportunity, time-sensitive internal matter
- MEDIUM: standard questions, FYI updates, routine requests
- LOW: newsletters, automated notifications, low-urgency items
- Classify as SPAM if unsolicited bulk mail or phishing

parameters.content:
## Google Sheets Setup

Create ONE Google Sheet with TWO tabs:

**Tab 1: ProcessedEmails** (dedup log)
Columns: messageId | subject | from | processedAt

**Tab 2: EmailLog** (full audit trail)
Columns: messageId | subject | from | date | category | priority | summary | requires_response | response_deadline | suggested_assignee | processedAt

Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID in all Google Sheets nodes.

## Gmail Labels Setup

Create these labels in Gmail before activating:
SUPPORT | SALES | HR | FINANCE | LEGAL
INTERNAL | NEWSLETTER | SPAM | OTHER

Then paste each label's ID into the labelMap
object in the "Parse AI Response" node.

How to find a label ID:
Gmail → Settings → See all settings → Labels
→ hover any label → ID appears in the URL
(e.g. .../#label/Label_12345678)
